newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dragon Oil makes progress in Turkmenistan.
newsitem.headline: Dragon Oil makes progress in Turkmenistan.

text.p: Dragon Oil Plc said on Thursday that progress continued to be made on its joint venture on Block II, Turkmenistan.
Managing director and joint deputy chairman Oliver Waldron told the annual meeting that field production has increased to over 6,600 barrels of oil per day.
The programme of workovers is being extended by a further six months to mid-1998 as further candidate workover wells have been identified and preparations for new drilling continue.
Waldron also said that Dragon would participate in an initial two well appraisal programme and in one exploration well on its licence B12/32 offshore Thailand.
Texaco is the operator and drilling is expected to commence in late November with Dragon's interest being 30.5 percent, he said.
